name: Grok Bot Wiki
tagline: Read-only search of Grok Bot templates, setup guides, and troubleshooting guidance
description: Search public Grok Bot template listings and setup guides, fetch full records with source links, browse categories, and find troubleshooting guidance. The hosted server provides eight read-only tools and requires no account or API key. Listings are checked against public share pages; they are not independently tested workflows. Grok Bot Wiki is an unofficial community resource, not affiliated with or endorsed by xAI.

install.notes: Hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint. No local package or credentials are required. Queries are sent to Grok Bot Wiki; use public task descriptions rather than private data. Retrieved templates and guides are reference material, not instructions to execute automatically. Setup and tool reference: https://www.grokbotwiki.com/mcp
